lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, showing increased spacing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical zones of increased luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of circular clusters, forming a non-orthogonal grid pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light to dark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Elongated, high-luminance feature attached to the integument immediately ventral to the anterior base of the first dorsal fin, discordant with the surrounding spot pattern.
